column3: BootUI reports a side-effect key gone only when its owner (route, execution or startup) was exercised, else NOT_EXERCISED; sharpit's owner is the pytest node id, because each test-runtime fingerprint is per test, and an unproved entry is inconclusive with a reason
BootUI counts any key or request of the owner as exercised; sharpit requires every call-phase report of the owner's deciding attempt to pass, because a test can stop before the code

BootUI does not compare a sensor that did not record a run whole (SideEffectComparison.java:76-80, 220-234), and when a sensor kept only some of its keys in this run it withholds gone keys and says how many (SideEffectComparison.java:84, 127-128, 135-137, 247-260); sharpit withholds every test-runtime entry on any unknown reason or session hook failure, the max-queries, N+1 and unbounded-read entries when the sqlite3 source lists evidence of untraced SQL in this run (a connection opened before capture started, a failed count of early connections, or a connection factory or cursor class it could not trace), and the unbounded-read entries alone when that source has a limitation; like BootUI it withholds only on evidence of this run, so the sqlalchemy note '<driver> calls outside SQLAlchemy are not traced', listed whenever the driver module is loaded, is a documented limitation and SQL sent through a raw untraced driver cursor beside SQLAlchemy can read fixed

BootUI side effects have no per-test gate to relax; sharpit re-evaluates every phase of every attempt of the owner with every gate unrelaxed, so a marker that loosened a gate cannot make an entry fixed, and a max-queries entry counts the queries of every phase for this check although the gate counts only the call phase, so queries moved into a fixture do not read as fixed
BootUI keys have no per-test fingerprint; a new finding of the same rule in the owner withholds fixed, because a changed identity cannot be told from a second finding
BootUI stores route and execution names in its run file; sharpit stores a sha256 digest of the node id, so test-id text is not added to the committed baseline

BootUI reports a key new only when the previous run exercised its owner, else NOT_EXERCISED (SideEffectComparison.java:103-107, 211-217); sharpit keeps every unlisted finding new, because the baseline stores no record of which tests the run that wrote it exercised, and a finding that is not reported new would pass the gate unseen, which would not fail closed

BootUI counts the keys whose owner was not exercised per sensor (notExercised) and lists each as a NOT_EXERCISED row with a sentence (SideEffectComparison.java:87, 103-106, 124-126, 174-182, 323-328); sharpit reports one inconclusive count for the baseline and lists each entry by fingerprint with the first of six reasons, because the baseline has no sensors and an entry can be unproved for reasons other than an unexercised owner

BootUI's comparison reads two recorded runs and writes nothing (SideEffectComparison.java:57-205), so it has no rewrite to keep an entry through; sharpit's --sharpit-write-baseline with --sharpit-baseline keeps every inconclusive entry, also while an advisor entry is carried, so an entry is never dropped on evidence the run did not have

BootUI does not report a key new or gone while its owner's work is still pending or absence is unknown, counts those keys and marks the sensor PARTIAL with a note (SideEffectComparison.java:99-101, 122-123, 139-169); sharpit has no pending owner, because the baseline is compared after the session ends, when every test's phases are reported, and an owner whose deciding attempt did not complete is inconclusive with the reason 'its test did not complete'

BootUI sorts changes by change kind, sensor, count descending, owner and target, and returns at most MAX_ROWS of them with the total (SideEffectComparison.java:184-203); sharpit sorts inconclusiveFindings by fingerprint and lists every entry beside the inconclusive count, because the entries are bounded by the committed baseline file and every inconclusive entry is one the rewrite keeps
